CREATE TABLE teacher_dialog_job (
    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    event_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (event_sequence > 0),
    source_message_id UUID NOT NULL,
    source_message_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (source_message_sequence > 0),
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    context_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    context_id UUID,
    learning_action_id UUID,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    claim_token UUID,
    locked_by VARCHAR(128),
    locked_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    decision_id UUID REFERENCES teacher_decision(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    response_body TEXT,
    delivered_message_id UUID,
    error_code VARCHAR(64),
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    UNIQUE (dialog_id, source_message_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id)
        REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id),
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (context_type IN ('general', 'lesson', 'lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')),
    CHECK (
        (context_type = 'general' AND context_id IS NULL AND learning_action_id IS NULL)
        OR
        (context_type = 'lesson' AND context_id IS NOT NULL AND learning_action_id IS NULL)
        OR
        (context_type IN ('lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project') AND context_id IS NOT NULL AND learning_action_id IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'delivery_pending', 'delivered', 'blocked')),
    CHECK ((status = 'processing') = (claim_token IS NOT NULL AND locked_by IS NOT NULL AND locked_until IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (status = 'processing' OR (claim_token IS NULL AND locked_by IS NULL AND locked_until IS NULL)),
    CHECK (response_body IS NULL OR (btrim(response_body) <> '' AND octet_length(response_body) <= 48000)),
    CHECK (
        (status = 'queued' AND decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL)
        OR
        (status = 'processing' AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL
            AND ((decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL) OR (decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL)))
        OR
        (status = 'delivery_pending' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL
            AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL)
        OR
        (status = 'delivered' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NULL
            AND delivered_message_id IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NULL)
        OR
        (status = 'blocked' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL
            AND delivered_at IS NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL)
    )
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_dialog_job_pending_idx
    ON teacher_dialog_job (next_attempt_at, occurred_at, event_id)
    WHERE status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'delivery_pending');
